services.name: Classic Full Set
services.description:
Enhance your natural beauty with our classic lash extensions, the perfect choice for a natural, everyday look. In this service, one lash extension is carefully applied to each individual natural eyelash by a licensed and expertly trained lash artist, offering a subtle boost in length, curl, and fullness. This is the most natural lash look you can choose. 

We offer a customized lash experience using a wide variety of lash lengths, curls, and styles. Choose from styles like cat eye, doll eye, open eye, and more. Your lash stylist will help you find the perfect shape and curl to complement your eye shape and personal style.

Whether you’re new to lash extensions or simply prefer a low maintenance, natural look, classic lashes are a beautiful way to enhance your everyday routine. They are especially great for first timers, and each appointment includes a custom styling consultation to create a look that fits you best. The result is a natural, soft, and lightweight finish, with the option to choose either black or brown lashes.

services.name: Classic Fill
services.subtitle: Maintain Your Classic Look
services.description: Maintain and refresh your natural, everyday lash look with a classic lash fill. This service replaces grown-out or shed lashes and new natural lash growth with new lash extensions to restore fullness and keep your lash set looking full and balanced. Ideal every 2–3 weeks.

services.name: Classic Mini Fill
services.subtitle: Quick Touch-Up
services.description: Need a quick refresh between full fills? A "mini fill" is perfect for light touch-ups when you’re within 7 days of your last lash appointment. Not for extended gaps or major lash extension loss.

services.name: Wet/Angel Full Set
services.description:
For those who love a wispy and soft lash look but want more bold than the classic lash extension style, our wet (aka angel style) lash extensions are the perfect choice. This technique uses closed, narrow volume fans in the form of a lash spike to create a textured or soft finish-perfect for clients who want something bolder than classic lashes but not as fluffy as hybrid lash extensions. 

Each wet or angel set is fully customized to your eye shape, natural lash health, and desired look, with style options like cat eye, doll eye, open eye, and more. These lash extensions have a clean, soft, and defined finish with a signature wispy look. A custom styling consultation is included, and black or brown color options are available.

services.name: Wet/Angel Fill
services.subtitle: Maintain Your Wispy Style
services.description: Maintain and refresh your wispy wet/angel lash set with a wet/angel lash fill. This service replaces grown-out or shed lashes and new natural lash growth with new lash extensions to restore fullness and keep your lash set looking full and balanced. Ideal every 2–3 weeks.

services.name: Wet/Angel Mini Fill
services.subtitle: Quick Refresh
services.description: Need a quick refresh between full fills? A "mini fill" is perfect for light touch-ups when you’re within 7 days of your last lash appointment. Not for extended gaps or major lash extension loss.

services.name: Hybrid Full Set
services.description:
Achieve a medium full look with hybrid lash extensions—a mix of classic and volume lash extensions for a fuller, more textured look that still feels natural and an every day lash look. This style combines individual classic lashes with light volume fans to add fullness  and texture, making it ideal for those who want a bit more fullness and glam without going full volume. This is our most popular style because it’s not too natural and not too dramatic but fullness can also be customized to your preferences.

Each hybrid full set is fully customized to your eye shape, natural lash health, and desired look, with style options like cat eye, doll eye, open eye, and more. Your lash stylist will help you choose the perfect shape and curl to complement your features and personal style. Hybrid lashes are a go to favorite because they offer the perfect balance of natural and full, creating soft but noticeable fullness that can be tailored to your preferences. A custom styling consultation is included, and black or brown color options are available.

services.name: Hybrid Fill
services.subtitle: Maintain Your Hybrid Style
services.description: Maintain and refresh your full and textured hybrid set with a hybrid lash fill. This service replaces grown-out or shed lashes and new natural lash growth with new lash extensions to restore fullness and keep your lash set looking full and balanced. Ideal every 2–3 weeks.

services.name: Hybrid Mini Fill
services.subtitle: Quick Touch-Up
services.description: Need a quick refresh between full fills? A "mini fill" is perfect for light touch-ups when you’re within 7–10 days of your last lash appointment. Not for extended gaps or major lash extension loss.

services.name: Volume Full Set
services.description:
Go full glam with volume lash extensions-designed for clients who love a bold, dense, and ultra-glam lash line. Using lightweight, handcrafted volume fans, we place multiple ultra fine lash fibers onto each natural lash, creating a fuller, fluffier and darker effect.

Our volume lash sets are never one size fits all. Every appointment includes a full lash consultation and custom mapping so we can create the perfect look for you, whether you want softer glam or full drama. This option is best for those wanting full, dense, dramatic lashes, and black or brown color options are available.

services.name: Volume Mini Fill
services.description:
Need a quick refresh between full fills? A "mini fill" is perfect for light touch-ups when you’re within 7–10 days of your last lash appointment.

-Not for extended gaps or major lash extension loss.

services.name: Mega Volume Full Set
services.description: A Mega Volume Full Set is the ultimate lash extension treatment for maximum drama, density, and fluffiness. Using ultra-fine extensions, we create custom, lightweight fans with up to 16 lashes per natural lash, achieving a bold, dark, and voluminous look.

services.name: Mega Volume Fill
services.description: Your lash stylist will remove any grown-out extensions and replace them with new extensions. They will then apply extensions to all newly grown in natural lashes, returning your lashes to the full set look. Fills are recommended every 2-3 weeks.

services.name: Mega Volume Mini Fill
services.description: A quick touch up of the mega volume style

services.name: Colored Eyelash Extensions
services.description: Colored lashes are an add-on service. Your choice from any colored extensions including red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink and white! All colors are available in normal, pastel and neon.

services.name: Removal
services.description: Your stylist will use a lash extension removal solution to safely remove all remaining extensions.

services.name: Lash Lift & Tint
services.description: A Lash Lift and Tint enhances your natural lashes using a two step process that lifts/curls the lashes upward to give them a longer appearance without the maintenance of lash extensions. A tint is then added to give your lashes a darker appearance. Low maintenance. Lasts 6-8 weeks.

services.name: Lash Lift
services.description: A Lash Lift enhances your natural lashes using a two step process that lifts/curls the lashes upward to give them a longer appearance without the maintenance of lash extensions. *Must add on a tint if needed. Low maintenance. Last 6-8wks.

services.name: Lash Tint
services.description: A Lash Tint will make your natural lashes appear darker. Lash Tint only. Last 4-6 weeks.

services.name: Lash Lift Reversal
services.description: A Lash Lift Reversal is great for lashes that have been over processed, too curled, or kinked. During this service the lashes will also be nourished.
